description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

 We are looking for a skilled  System Engineer (Cloud & AI) to design, deploy and operate our cloud and on-prem infrastructure, keep production stable and automated. You'll work across multiple cloud providers, automate everything as code, and bring modern AI tooling into day-to-day operations. As a System Engineer at Super, you'll design, deploy, operate and continuously harden our cloud and on-prem infrastructure across multiple environments — keeping production stable, automated and scalable — while bringing modern AI tooling into the operations workflow (AI-assisted automation, supporting AI/ML workloads, and AI-augmented runbooks/self-service).

  

  

 What the role involves

 
 Own reliability of our multi-environment platform across AWS, GCP, and on-prem virtualization .

 Build and operate infrastructure as code with Terraform across core domains: compute, storage, databases, IAM, DNS, certificates, and managed services (e.g. AWS : EC2/RDS/S3/CloudFront/ALB/Route 53/KMS/EKS/ECS; GCP : Compute Engine/Cloud SQL/Cloud Storage/Load Balancing/Cloud DNS/Cloud KMS/GKE).

 Improve cost, scalability, and performance; understand billing models and right-sizing levers across clouds.

 Operate and harden production systems (Linux + Windows): patching, lifecycle maintenance, fleet tooling/agents, and incident response (MTTR-focused).

 Run critical internet-facing foundations: email infrastructure and security posture ( SPF/DKIM/DMARC/ARC ), plus DNS and TLS/ACME certificate automation.

 Automate operations with scripts/playbooks ( Python/Bash/Go ) in a PR-based workflow; build self-service and reduce recurring toil (runbooks, DNS/cert changes, etc.).

 Improve observability and reliability (monitoring/alerting; Prometheus/Grafana/SNMP/exporters/agents) and collaborate cross-functionally on upgrades and scaling.

 Support security and internal tooling: remediate findings (SAST, headers, dependency issues), harden services, and help maintain internal infra web apps (Node/Go/PHP).

 
  

  

 What we are looking for

 
 Demonstrated experience operating production infrastructure across cloud and virtualized/on-prem environments.

 Strong Linux systems administration skills, with proven ability to run, troubleshoot, and harden production services.

 Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (preferred: Terraform ), with an automation-first approach.

 Strong scripting skills (e.g. Python, Bash, Node, Go, PHP) to automate, integrate, and operationalize systems.

 Multi-cloud experience , ideally across AWS and GCP (compute, storage, databases, identity, DNS, and managed services).

 Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker + Kubernetes; EKS/GKE/ECS).

 A strong security mindset (least privilege, robust secret hygiene, and a focus on root-cause remediation).

 Strong problem-solving, ownership, and communication skills.

 Base in Zagreb, Žilina or Bucharest

 
  

  

 How you work

 
 Apply an evidence-driven approach to troubleshooting: review primary signals (logs, metrics) before forming conclusions, and reproduce issues where appropriate.

 Demonstrate sound judgment by identifying root causes and avoiding unverified or short-term workarounds.

 Take a proactive approach to incident prevention; maintain composure and a solution-oriented mindset.

 Communicate clearly and document thoroughly, ensuring outcomes are captured in run books and shared back with stakeholders.

 Collaborate effectively across teams to accelerate resolution and drive continuous improvement.

 
  

  

 What we offer

 
 Medical / Health Insurance

 Open Annual Leave

 Employee Assistance Programme

 Training & Learning Development

 
  

 Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

  

  
 About Super 

 We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

 Shaping the Future of Play 

 Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page:  super.xyz/careers  

 Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). 

 At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.
